name: How do I choose the right contractor for my basement remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my basement remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a licensed, insured contractor who provides hands-on oversight and a clear division of project responsibilities. Inquire whether the business owner manages the job site directly and who will perform trades like framing, drywall, custom tile, and painting versus licensed electrical and plumbing partners. Check for strong local references, an established track record, and credentials such as BBB accreditation. Transparent communication regarding milestones, change orders, and sub-trade scheduling is critical for a smooth renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select an insured, BBB-accredited contractor with hands-on site management, clear trade coordination, and strong local remodeling experience.
